scope: Pre-migration mandatory estimation-runtime workflow; preserve every non-lagd command and source/IPC/sanitizer gate. No runtime output expected values.

steps.run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y g++ clang libclang-dev capnproto libcapnp-dev libzmq3-dev
python -m pip install numpy==2.5.3 pycapnp==2.1.0 Cython==3.2.4 setuptools==82.0.1 cffi==2.1.1 sympy==1.14.0 pyzmq==27.2.0 zstandard==0.25.0 requests==2.34.2 pyserial==3.5 pytest==9.0.2

steps.name: Check atomic paramsd fixture input boundaries
Install source-pinned Eigen headers
steps.run:
python -m pip install 'git+https://github.com/commaai/dependencies.git@40e5d76de1b33a86c5181b63db6782d8f06da1da#subdirectory=eigen'
python -c 'import eigen; print("LOCATIOND_EIGEN_INCLUDE=" + eigen.INCLUDE_DIR); print("PARAMSD_EIGEN_INCLUDE=" + eigen.INCLUDE_DIR)' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Build native estimators and unchanged source oracle
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd"
python rust/tools/build_locationd_oracle.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --eigen-include "$LOCATIOND_EIGEN_INCLUDE"
python rust/tools/build_paramsd_oracle.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/paramsd-oracle" --eigen-include "$PARAMSD_EIGEN_INCLUDE" --reuse-wrapper "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle"/ekf_sym_pyx*.so
python rust/tools/build_params_python.py --json11-stager "$JSON11_STAGER" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation-params-binding"
cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p openpilot-locationd -p openpilot-lagd -p openpilot-paramsd --bins --examples --locked

steps.name: Compare location model, complete source loop, timestamps and native IPC
steps.run:
python rust/tools/check_locationd.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --trace "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/location_trace" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/estimator"
python rust/tools/check_locationd_loop.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --trace "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/location_loop" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/loop"
python rust/tools/check_locationd_timestamp.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --trace "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/location_trace" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/timestamp"
python rust/tools/check_locationd_daemon.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --target "$PWD/rust/target" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/daemon"
python rust/tools/check_locationd_startup.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/locationd-oracle" --binding "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation-params-binding"/params_pyx*.so --binary "$PWD/rust/target/debug/openpilot-locationd" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/startup"

steps.name: Compare vehicle model, source main loop, cache migration and native IPC
steps.run:
python rust/tools/check_paramsd.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/paramsd-oracle" --trace "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/paramsd_trace" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/paramsd/estimator"
python rust/tools/check_paramsd_loop.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/paramsd-oracle" --trace "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/paramsd_loop" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/paramsd/loop"
python rust/tools/check_paramsd_daemon.py --oracle "$RUNNER_TEMP/paramsd-oracle" --target "$PWD/rust/target" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/paramsd/daemon"
python rust/tools/check_paramsd_startup.py --binary "$PWD/rust/target/debug/openpilot-paramsd" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/paramsd/startup"

steps.name: Compare delay numerical policy, full source loop, cache and native IPC
steps.run:
python rust/tools/check_lagd_numeric.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/lag_numeric" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/numeric.json"
python rust/tools/check_lagd_loop.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/lag_loop" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/loop"
python rust/tools/check_lagd_cache.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/lag_cache" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/cache.json"
python rust/tools/check_lagd_packet.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/lag_packet" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/packet.json"
python rust/tools/check_lagd_daemon.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/openpilot-lagd" "$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/lag_ipc_peer" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/daemon"
python rust/tools/check_lagd_params_io.py "$PWD/rust/target/debug/openpilot-lagd" "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/params-io.json"

steps.name: Check production numerical ownership and native memory boundaries
steps.run:
cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p openpilot-locationd -p openpilot-lagd -p openpilot-paramsd -p openpilot-pocketfft --locked
python rust/tools/check_locationd_native.py --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/locationd/native"
python rust/tools/check_paramsd_native.py --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/paramsd/native"
clang++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -ffp-contract=off -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer rust/crates/pocketfft/native/kernel_test.cc -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/pocketfft-sanitized"
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/pocketfft-sanitized" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/estimation/lagd/pocketfft-sanitizer.log" 2>&1
